run_hydra_train: run fairseq model training using Hydra configuration management and distributed utilities
run_hydra_main: run the hydra_main function to start training with a FairseqConfig object
run_cli_main: run the cli_main entry point to initialize Hydra and start fairseq training
run_hydra_sweep: run a Hydra hyperparameter sweep that returns the best validation metric value
run_profiled_training: run fairseq training with CUDA and NVTX profiler enabled for performance analysis
